best_for: Windows users who want to find what fills an NTFS drive in seconds, and businesses willing to buy a supporter code to use it at work.
description:
WizTree is a disk space analyzer from Antibody Software, the small company behind WizFile, WizMouse and Bulk Image Downloader. It answers one question: which files and folders are eating your drive.

After a scan, a tree map draws every file as a block sized by how much space it takes, so the space hogs jump out at you. A separate list ranks the largest files on the drive. WizTree counts hard-linked files only once, so the total it shows should match what Windows reports. It can also scan network drives and drives that are not NTFS. You can search files with advanced filters, copy file and folder data to the clipboard, or export it to a CSV file, including from the command line.

points.title: Fast because it reads the MFT
points.text: On NTFS drives WizTree reads the Master File Table straight from the disk instead of walking every folder, so a full drive scans in seconds rather than minutes.

points.title: Speed needs admin rights
points.text: The fast MFT scan works only when WizTree runs as administrator. You can turn that off in Options, but scans then slow down.

points.title: Free at home, paid at work
points.text: Personal use is free. Commercial use needs a supporter code, priced by staff count: USD 25 for an individual, USD 100 for up to 5 staff, up to USD 750 for one enterprise site. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Codes cover a year of updates
points.text: A code is perpetual and covers all devices at one site, but free upgrades last only for versions released within a year of purchase. Renewals get 50% off.

points.title: Portable and duplicates
points.text: A portable version keeps its settings beside the program. WizTree can also find duplicate files.

points.title: This listing is Windows
points.text: The installers here cover x86 and x64 and install for all users; there is no Arm64 build listed. The Windows listing keeps 18 versions. Antibody Software also makes WizTreeMac, which is not listed on this page.
